name: dg-scss-color-preview
description: Inline color previews for SCSS variables, CSS custom properties, and selected derived color patterns.

scssColorPreview.enabled.description: Enable inline color swatches for SCSS variables and CSS custom properties.

scssColorPreview.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of CSS/SCSS files to index in the workspace (SCSS/Sass files are indexed first). WordPress core, plugins, node_modules, vendor and build folders are always skipped.

scssColorPreview.exclude.description: Additional glob patterns to skip when indexing, e.g. **/legacy/**.

scssColorPreview.contrastOutline.description: Draw a subtle outline around colors that blend into the editor background (e.g. near-black on a dark theme).

enumDescriptions: Split the underline: the first three characters show the light value, the rest the dark value.
Only preview the light value of light-dark().
Only preview the dark value of light-dark().
scssColorPreview.lightDark.description: How colors defined with light-dark() are previewed.
